content: Hixɨapa kememɨteyutsanaxɨ 'ixaheritsixi
Hikɨ Xuwuhani kaneyani Tsikeni paitɨ, mana yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi memeyuxeɨriekaikɨ ti'aitame memeyeitɨanikɨ.
Hikɨ mɨkɨ hepaɨtsita Keruwuhani Nawati nu'aya katiniutamarieni, meripaitɨ ti'aitame Tsarumuni 'ayemakatɨ 'Ekipitu meyakai meta mana 'akuxi pukatei.
Kepauka 'ixaheritsixi kɨmana memɨte'utanɨ'a mɨ'atɨarie, hikɨ mɨkɨ meta yunaitɨ memɨyuxeɨriekai 'ixaheritsixi mekanekɨne Xuwuhani hetsɨa mɨpaɨ mekateneitahɨawe:
—'Apaapa kwinimieme raheteme yuku pɨtatsi'utitɨtɨa teka'ikemakame. Hikɨri 'ekɨ ha'exanime ketaneutitɨtɨa te'ikemakame, keyuri 'apaapa mɨtatsi'utitɨtɨa, hikɨ 'ana tepɨmateta'uximayatsirieni.
Xuwuhani mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xekeneuhuni hikɨ, peru xekenayenexɨa haika tukari 'anukayayu. Hikɨ kepauka teɨteri memekɨ,
ti'aitame Xuwuhani kaniwaruta'iwawiya 'ukirawetsixi paapaya Tsarumuni mayeyurikaitsie memɨparewiekai. Mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'iwawiya: —¿Kexehaitɨka xeme, kenetiwata'eiya 'ikɨ teɨteri?

Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —Xɨka 'ekɨ ti'aitame hikɨ 'ikɨ teɨteri tiwa'uximayatsiriwame pe'ayani, xɨka kemɨtiwanake pewaru'enieni, xɨka pewaruta'eiya pewanaki'erietɨ, mɨkɨ mepɨmateta'uximayatsirieni yuheyemekɨ.
Peru Xuwuhani 'ukirawetsixi wa'ɨxatsi pɨka'anu'eni kememɨte'itahɨawixɨ, matsi temari pɨtata kaniwaruta'iwawiya hamatɨana memutiwawerixɨ meta 'anari memiparewiekai.
Mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'iwawiya: —¿Kexehaitɨka xeme, kenetiwata'eiya 'ikɨ teɨteri mɨpaɨ memɨnetekɨhɨawe: “Ha'exanime kenayeitɨa 'apaapa kwinimieme raheteme yuku mɨtatsi'utitɨtɨa teka'ikemakame”?

Mɨkɨ temari, hamatɨana memutiwawerixɨ, mɨpaɨ mekatenita'eiya: —'Ikɨ teɨteri 'ipaɨ memɨmetehahɨawe ti'aitame: “'Apaapa kwinimieme raheteme yuku pɨtatsi'utitɨtɨa, 'ekɨri ha'exanime kenayeitɨa”. Neuxei, 'ipaɨ ketiniwaruta'eiya: “Xɨka nepaapa waɨkawa tixe'uta'uximayatsitɨani, ne matsi tawari waɨkawa nepɨtixeta'uximayatsitɨani.
Xɨka mɨkɨ yuku haheteme xe'utitɨtɨani, neta matsi waɨkawa nepɨxeti'ikatɨani. Xɨka mɨkɨ xetiwayakaitɨni kɨyekɨ, ne kawayutsixi wawayamekɨ tepɨa manuyatsatɨkakɨ nepɨxetiwani”.
Merikɨte hairieka tukari 'aye'aku, kemutayɨkai ti'aitame Xuwuhani, hɨxiena Keruwuhani kaninuani yunaime teɨteri wahamatɨa.
Peru ti'aitame kaniwaruta'eiya tiyukananaimakamekɨ: 'ukirawetsixi 'ɨxatsi memipitɨakai pɨka'anu'eni,

matsi temari wa'ɨxatsi pɨta kaniu'enieni. Mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Xɨka nepaapa yuku haheteme xe'utitɨtɨani, neta matsi waɨkawa nepɨxeti'ikatɨani. Xɨka mɨkɨ xetiwayakaitɨni kɨyekɨ, ne kawayutsixi wawayamekɨ tepɨa manuyatsatɨkakɨ nepɨxetiwani».

Hikɨ ti'aitame teɨteri pɨkawaru'eni. Mɨpaɨ pɨtiɨyɨ Yawé yahainekaku, maye'atɨarienikɨ 'ari Keruwuhani Nawati nu'aya kemɨtiutahɨawekai, Kakaɨyari niukameya 'Ahiyaxi Tsiru kiekame Keruwuhani yapɨtiutahɨawekairi.
Kepauka memɨtehetima kename ti'aitame 'ari kawaru'eni, yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ mekateniuhiwakaitɨni meyuxewitɨ:
Hikɨ mekaneutayeixɨani, yuxexuitɨ yukie.
Peru mɨyatɨtɨ, Xuwuhani piyeweiyakai ti'aitatɨ 'ixaheritsixi wahetsie Kura kiekariteyaritsie memutetɨkatei.

Hikɨ 'arikeke, ti'aitame Xuwuhani 'Arunirani kanenɨ'ani waɨriyarika memɨte'uximaya mɨhɨritɨariekai mɨnierimiekɨ, peru yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi tetexikɨ mekaneitituaxixɨani mekanimieni. Hikɨ mexɨiwa ti'aitame 'anutiyerɨka yukaxetatsie kaniyuta'una Kerutsareme paitɨ.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ tiɨyɨku 'anatɨtɨ 'ixaheritsixi Rawiri nuiwarimama mepɨwaruku'eiri, hikɨ yaxeikɨa mepɨ'ane.

'Ixaheritsixi kepauka memɨte'utamari kename Keruwuhani hakunuakai, mɨkɨ mekanitakwewieni yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi, hikɨ mekanenukakeni ti'aitame mayanikɨ naime 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie miemekɨ. Nixewitɨ Rawiri niwemama wanaki'erietɨ pɨkahatɨa, Kura nuiwarimama xeikɨa.

Xuwuhani Tsarumuni nu'aya Kerutsareme nuaka kaniwarukuxeɨrieni yunaime Kura nuiwarimama meta Wenikamini nuiwarimama, xeitsienituyari heimana nauka tewiyari miriyari (180.000) kuyaxi mekanakɨne yunaitɨ, mɨwatakwinikɨ 'ixaheritsixi hikɨ mɨpaɨ tiyurieme yunaime wahetsie mɨtita'aitakɨ.
Peru Kakaɨyari niukieya kaninuani Tsemahiyaxi hetsɨa, mɨkɨ tewi Kakaɨyari payexeiyakai, mɨpaɨ 'aneme niuki kaniupitɨarieni:
«Mɨpaɨ ketineutahɨawi Xuwuhani Tsarumuni nu'aya mɨti'aitame Kura kwieyaritsie, yunaime Kura tɨɨriyamama meta Wenikamini nuiwarimama metatsiere yunaime teɨteri,

mɨpaɨ kanaineni Yawé: “Hawaikɨ xepɨkawakwitɨweni yu'iwama 'ixaheritsixi. Yuxexuitɨ yukie xekeneutayeixɨa, karikɨ ne yanehainekaku mɨya pɨtiɨyɨ”». Hikɨ mɨkɨ mekanenu'enieni Yawé niukieya, mekaniukunuaxɨani, Yawé kemutayɨkai.
Keruwuhani tsikerutsixi kakaɨyarixiyari kemɨtiwarutiwewi
Keruwuhani Tsikeni kiekariyari 'aixɨa kaniuyurieni 'Epɨrahini hɨriyaritsie mukumakai, hikɨ mana kaniuyuhayewa. 'Arike Tsikeni 'uku'eirieka, Peniheri kiekariyari 'aixɨa kaniuyurieni.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨta pɨtiyuti'iyaritɨa: «Nɨkahɨrixɨata Rawiri niwemama mete'aitatɨ mehakɨne naimetsie.

Xɨka teɨteri Kerutsareme meheta'axeni memɨtehetimawakɨ Yawé tukita, mɨpaɨ meyɨatɨ mepanuaxɨani ti'aitame Xuwuhani hetsɨa Kura kwieyaritsie mɨti'aita. Hikɨ 'ana mepɨnetsimieni, 'imatɨrieka mɨkɨ pɨta mepɨtinɨni».

Hikɨ 'uti'iwauka kemɨtiyurieni, ti'aitame yuhutame tsikerutsixi kaniwarutiwewieni hurukɨ, hikɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe teɨteri: «'Ixaheritsixi, pɨkaheuyewetse xemeta'axeni 'akuxi Kerutsareme. 'Ena mekaniti'uka xekakaɨyarixima, 'Ekipitu memɨxe'ayewitɨ».
Hikɨ yuxeime tsikeru Weteri kiekariyaritsie kaniutakeni, xeimeta Rani kiekariyaritsie.
Merikɨte mɨkɨkɨ kwinimieme 'axamekateniuyurieni 'ixaheritsixi, hipatɨ 'atsita Rani kiekariyaritsie paitɨ mekaneta'axekaitɨni memɨte'itimawirienikɨ tsikeru mana mɨyewekai.
Keruwuhani kanitiwewienita kakaɨyarixi watuki hɨritetsie, meta kaniwarutihɨawe mawari wewiwamete muwa memɨte'uximayakakɨ hipame teɨteri, tsepa Rewi xiɨyarieya mɨkahɨkɨ kaniwaranuka'uitɨani.

'Aitsika kaniunetɨani 'ixɨarari hepaɨtsita mieme 'atahaika metseriyaritsie tamamata heimana 'auxɨwi tukariyaritsie memetinenetɨwanikɨ, 'ixɨarari Kura kwieyaritsie matineikakai hepaɨ 'aneme. Weteri kiekariyaritsie mawari taiyametsie tsikerutsixi katiniwarutimawirieni mɨwarutiwewi, meta mawari wewiwamete kaniwarutihɨawe kakaɨyarixi watuki mana mutiwewiekaita memɨte'uximayakakɨ.

Merikɨte 'aye'aku, tamamata heimana 'auxɨwi tukaritsie 'atahaika metseritsie, Keruwuhani mɨratimawatɨre kaneyani mitawewitsie Weteri kiekariyaritsie, mana 'ɨkwa taiyariyari kaniuwewiweni. Mɨkɨ tukaritsie mepuhɨritɨarie meme'eriwanikɨ yuheyemekɨ 'ixɨarari tukariyari mɨhɨkɨtɨnikɨ 'ixaheritsixi wahetsiemieme.
